title: Peasants, Zamindars and the State: Agrarian Society and the Mughal Empire

concepts.learning_objective: Identify the main sources for Mughal agrarian history and explain why the Ain gives a view from the top.
Distinguish between khud-kashta and pahi-kashta peasants and the reasons people became pahi-kashta.
Explain the size of peasant holdings and the principle of individual ownership of land.

topics.title: Irrigation, technology and an abundance of crops

concepts.learning_objective: Relate rainfall and the kharif and rabi cycles to the staple crops grown in Mughal India.
Describe the irrigation devices and agricultural tools used by peasants.
Explain jins-i kamil and the spread of new crops such as tobacco and maize.
Explain how caste shaped the position of different groups in rural society.
Describe the functions of village panchayats, jati panchayats and headmen, and peasant resistance.
Explain how village artisans were paid and evaluate the idea of the village as a little republic.
Describe the roles of women in agricultural and artisanal production.
Explain social customs such as bride-price and remarriage in peasant communities.
Evaluate the property rights of women and their petitions to the panchayat.
Describe the extent of forests and the livelihood of forest dwellers termed jangli.
Analyse how the state, commerce and culture made inroads into forest areas.
Explain how tribal chiefs became zamindars or kings and built armies.
Identify the sources of the zamindars' power, including milkiyat lands and military resources.
Explain how zamindaris originated and were consolidated, and their role in colonising land.
Evaluate the element of reciprocity and patronage in zamindar-peasant relations.

topics.title: Land revenue system and the flow of silver

concepts.learning_objective: Explain the stages of assessment (jama) and collection (hasil) and the methods of collection in kind.
Classify lands under Akbar and calculate the revenue demand from the medium produce.
Explain how the flow of silver into India affected currency and revenue collection.

topics.title: The Ain-i Akbari of Abu'l Fazl Allami

concepts.learning_objective: Describe the purpose and the organisation of the Ain into its five daftars.
Evaluate the strengths and limitations of the Ain as a historical source.
